method.composition: Spectral class, or albedo when no class is measured, mapped to meteorite analog groups with published mass-fraction ranges (app/prospect/composition.py).
method.mass: Measured GM and density from the JPL SBDB where published, otherwise diameter and the group's mean bulk density.
method.reach: Rough rendezvous cost from Earth's orbit (Hohmann, plane change, eccentricity term), for ordering only.
method.ranking: log10(expected tonnes) - 1.2 x reach in km/s, per resource and overall.
